arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Edge case tests for R3

# Test: {{ followed by unbalanced }
try:
    p = parse.Parser('{{text} extra')
    print('ERROR: Should have raised ValueError for {{text} extra')
except ValueError as e:
    print(f'{{{{text}} extra raises ValueError: OK')

# Test: single { without closing
try:
    p = parse.Parser('{name')
    print('ERROR: Should have raised ValueError')
except ValueError as e:
    print(f'Unmatched {{ at end raises ValueError: OK')

# Test: single } without opening
try:
    p = parse.Parser('text}')
    print('ERROR: Should have raised ValueError')  
except ValueError as e:
    print(f'Single }} without opening raises ValueError: OK')

# Test: multiple nested fields work fine
p = parse.Parser('{a} {b} {c}')
r = p.parse('1 2 3')
print(f'Multiple fields: {r.fixed}')

# Test: escaped + field mixed
p = parse.Parser('{{prefix_}} {name}')
r = p.parse('{prefix_} John')
print(f'Mixed escaped + field: {r.named}')

# Test: empty braces {}
p = parse.Parser('{}')
r = p.parse('test')
print(f'Empty braces: {r.fixed}')

print('\\nAll edge case tests passed!')
" 2>&1 | grep -v SyntaxWarning
